current_evidence: The council's 'Apply for planning permission' page says it 'has updated its existing national and local validation lists' and links 'Validation table January 2025' and 'Validation lists supporting document January 2025'; it no longer links the 2019 PDF.

issues.detail: Workbook uses the 2019 Local Validation Requirements (adopted 23 April 2019, due for review 2021). The council page now links January 2025 validation lists (Validation table Jan 2025 + supporting document Jan 2025). The .docx files could not be read via WebFetch, so the comparison below is against the 2019 list only.
issues.evidence: apply-for-planning-permission page: 'Validation table January 2025', 'Validation lists supporting document January 2025'

issues.detail: List date stored as 2019-04-01 but the text says adopted 23 April 2019 (and the current list is January 2025).

Householder recorded as '(none)', but section 2 requires floor/elevation/roof plans, a layout plan showing adjoining properties and windows, a block plan showing lowered kerb/hard surfacing/drainage where vehicular access is created or altered, and a tree survey where protected or significant trees are affected. Listed building consent also recorded as '(none)' but requires floor/elevation/roof plans, schedule of works and heritage impact statement. Reserved matters, LDC, discharge of conditions, NMA, demolition in conservation area and works to trees also have local items but are shown as '(none)'.

About 24 items placed under Full planning as 'INFERRED' though the list is organised by application type. Examples: 'Lawful development evidence (statutory declarations)' belongs to LDC (s17); 'Schedule of works (listed building)' excerpt is TPO tree-works text; 'Arboricultural Impact Assessment' excerpt is TPO works text; 'Agricultural/rural workers' dwelling appraisal' excerpt is the marketing report for removing an occupancy condition (Variation, s18); 'Design Code/Masterplan' ('an illustrative masterplan') belongs to Outline; 'Telecommunications' excerpt is a list of prior approval types. 'Pre-application advice' is put under Outline and s73 but is advice, not a requirement.

Not captured: River Mease impact statement (development in River Mease catchment creating dwellings/annexes/commercial floorspace); Coal mining risk assessment (high-risk coal area); Daylight and sunlight assessment (high-rise or commercial over 8m to eaves); Soil quality survey (loss of grade 1-3 land); Minerals extraction feasibility study (major development in Minerals Safeguarding Area); Community facilities analysis (loss of community facility/ACV); Retail sequential and impact assessments (main town centre uses outside centres; >1,000 m2); Business plan (rural business); Rural enterprise statement; Equalities impact statement; Drawing schedule and topographical survey (major); Planning obligations statement (10+ dwellings); Swept path drawings; Conditions tracker (phased sites); Contaminated land, Transport assessment/Travel plan, Ecology (PEA), LVIA.

'Submission rules' tab items are process text and fragments: file naming example 'Site Layout - 9453_07 Rev A.pdf).', redaction/privacy paragraphs, paper copies; the hedgerow item is a definition of a protected hedgerow, not a requirement.

Several triggers are cut fragments that do not state when the item applies: Landscaping 'levels/sections or landscaping details.'; Roof plan 'elevation drawings; roof plans;'; SCI '15 metres; a statement of community involvement.'; Planning obligations 'conservation area. a section 106 agreement; an enforcement notice...'. Source triggers: FRA in flood zone 2/3 or site over 1 ha; SCI for major development not in accordance with the Development Plan.

summary: Grokbot used the superseded 2019 list; the council now publishes January 2025 validation lists (Word documents that could not be read here). Even against the 2019 list, Grokbot left Householder and LBC empty and missed many constraint-driven requirements such as the River Mease impact statement and coal mining risk assessment.
